root_idea.summary: The root centers on causing one thing to fall upon, affect, or be applied to another; its uses extend from striking to travel, imprinting, comparison, imposition, and related forms of impact or movement.
root_idea.development: The basic notion of striking or making an impact is extended metaphorically to journeying across the earth, laying or imposing something over another, producing an impression or likeness, and setting forth a parable or way.

senses.definition: to strike, hit, beat, or smite; to inflict a blow or physical impact
senses.usage_conditions: Includes active and passive constructions, striking with a hand, weapon, or other object, and striking a bodily part; in context it can extend to smiting or killing.

senses.definition: to travel, go forth, or journey through the land
senses.usage_conditions: Used with فِي الأَرْضِ and related constructions for going about or journeying, including travel for a purpose such as seeking provision.

senses.definition: to set forth, present, compare, or propound a parable, example, or similitude
senses.usage_conditions: Used with مَثَلًا and related objects; the construction may present a case as an illustrative comparison or make something the subject of a parable.

senses.definition: to lay, cast, impose, or set something over or upon another; hence to cover, enclose, or establish a barrier
senses.usage_conditions: Includes imposing a condition, laying a covering or veil over something, causing sleep by covering the ears, and setting a separating wall or barrier between parties.

senses.definition: to assign, make, or open a way or route
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the construction ضرب طريقًا, including making a route through or across a place such as the sea.

senses.definition: to turn away, dismiss, or withhold from a person, matter, or subject
senses.usage_conditions: The construction ضرب عن can mean turning away from or neglecting something; in discourse it can indicate digression or withdrawal from a subject.
A verbal noun denoting the act of striking; it may occur in an absolute construction or in the expression ضرب الرقاب, striking the necks.

senses.definition: journeying or moving about in the land
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun used for going about or traveling through the land, especially in pursuit of livelihood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to beat, discipline, or train an animal for a purpose
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of beating or training a dog for the chase.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to cast, throw, or fling something onto the ground; euphemistically, to void excrement
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a person, thing, or bodily waste.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to play a lute or other wind instrument
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of striking the strings of a lute and, by extension, playing it; the term also applies to playing a reed, trumpet, or similar instrument by means of breath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to make firm by striking; to pitch or set up a tent
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes striking a tent peg into the ground and setting up a tent by driving in its pegs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to coin or mint money
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of striking a dirham or other piece of money, including coining it in someone's name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to seal or stamp writing; to erase written material
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى and a written object or inscription.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to apply or stick one material upon another, especially plaster upon a wall
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes applying mud or another substance as a coating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to impose a tax, levy, obligation, or fixed payment upon someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes an impost such as poll-tax or land-tax and an obligation appointed or laid upon a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to cast a net or snare over something
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of throwing a net or trap over a bird or other prey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to cast the folds of darkness over a place; of night, to come or become dark
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in which night is treated as spreading a covering over the earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a scorpion, to sting
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of striking applied to the scorpion's sting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to be smitten and damaged by cold, wind, hoarfrost, or rime
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of herbage, land, or other vegetation affected by severe cold or frost.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of rain, to fall upon a road or tract
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in describing whether rain has fallen on a particular road.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a male animal, to mate with or cover a female
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a stallion leaping or covering a she-camel; the related noun ضِرَاب can denote the mating or its hire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to mix or intermingle one thing with another
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of mixing substances, especially milk of different consistencies or milk collected from different animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to implant or engender a quality, strain, or hereditary disposition
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively of a person or woman introducing a dubious or bad strain into a family or people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to shuffle or cast gaming arrows, practise sortilege, or participate in the arrow game
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may also mean obtaining a share in the slaughtered animal or assigning a share of property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a share or portion allotted or obtained
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal extension from the idea of an assigned portion in gaming or property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to move the arms about or to swim
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The phrase ضرب في الماء may omit the understood reference to moving the hands in the water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to gesture, point, extend a hand toward something, or apply oneself to an action
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The hand may be extended to indicate, take, or undertake something; the verb can also occur without an expressed object for making a sign.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to ratify a bargain or sale by striking or clasping another's hand
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression based on the customary hand gesture used to conclude an agreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to restrain, prohibit, prevent, or place someone under legal restriction
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of withholding a person from an action or restricting the disposal of property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to corrupt, spoil, mar, or disorder an affair or state
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use applied to a matter, case, or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to remain, stay, or abide in a place
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a place, tent, house, or other location, often with the sense of settling there and not leaving.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to show cowardice, fear, shame, or bashfulness by clinging to the ground
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression includes lowering or pressing the chin to the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to seek or pursue something throughout the land, especially livelihood or glory
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a desired gain, sustenance, or distinction; the sense emphasizes energetic pursuit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to make, fashion, mould, or form an object; hence to give a natural disposition
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The nominal ضَرِيبَة can denote a nature or innate disposition conceived as a moulded constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to specify or appoint a term or period
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an object such as a deadline or duration assigned to a person or matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to multiply one number by another
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical mathematical use of the verbal noun ضَرْبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to move, stir, pulse, or be in a state of commotion
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing movement, agitation, or disturbance; the derived form اضطرب intensifies the sense of disorder or tumult.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a vein, wound, or tooth, to throb or cause violent pain
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun ضَرَبَانٌ may denote the pulsation or accompanying pain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a she-camel, to raise its tail and strike its vulva with it
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the camel's movement after mating or during pregnancy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a camel, to take fright and run away at random
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes continued galloping until the camel throws off its load or furniture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of time or fortune, to pass, produce events, or separate people
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression can describe part of time passing, events coming to pass, or time creating distance between people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become long, especially of the night
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a night that has lengthened for those experiencing it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to incline toward a color or quality
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَى to describe tending toward blackness, redness, or another quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to excite, incite, urge, or instigate people toward strife or action
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II may denote stirring discord among people or rousing a courageous person to ardor in battle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to quilt or sew padding into a garment, cover, or spread
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle مُضَرَّبٌ and noun مُضَرَّبَةٌ refer to quilted material or a quilt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to expose oneself to snow or hoarfrost
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: thick, white, or wild honey; also honey in the comb
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related derived forms may describe honey becoming thick or white, or milk or honey so characterized.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to contend or exchange blows with someone; to fight against him
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III emphasizes reciprocal or competitive striking and may include overcoming an opponent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to engage in profit-sharing trade with property
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III denotes the commercial partnership in which one party supplies property and the gain is shared.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to cause a stallion to cover a she-camel
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV is causative in this specialized animal-breeding construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to dispose, accommodate, or subject oneself to an affair
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the self as being prepared or made ready for an undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of hot wind, to cause the earth to absorb or dry up water
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized environmental use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become silent, refrain from speaking, or lower the eyes
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The latter sense is synonymous with looking down or remaining silent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of bread baked in ashes, to become thoroughly baked and ready to be beaten clean
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to beat or strike oneself repeatedly or violently
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reflexive Form V conveys repeated or intensive self-directed striking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to strike or fight one another
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used reciprocally of people exchanging blows, including blows with swords or sticks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to be loose, lax, shaky, or incongruous in physical make
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or body whose structure is tall but weak, flabby, or uncompact.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become confused, discordant, unsettled, or unsound
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe speech, opinions, affairs, or relations that conflict, vary, or become disordered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: still or motionless
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a serpent that remains still.

other_classical_meanings.definition: bad or broken pieces of a plant
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use applied to a kind of plant or to plant material broken into pieces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the head
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative naming associated with agitation or movement of the head.

other_classical_meanings.definition: big-bellied
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description applied to people and other beings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the place or part of a body upon which a blow falls
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal specialization referring to the target of striking rather than the blow itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a portion of wool, hair, or cotton prepared by beating, separating, or spinning
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes wool or hair separated and folded for spinning and wool beaten with a mallet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a nature, innate disposition, or temperament
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use for a person's natural character or constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a she-camel, to resist or strike away the milker
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a camel that becomes difficult to milk, especially after conception.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a depressed or elongated place or valley containing trees
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun for a hollow or tract extending through level ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a snare for catching birds
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrumental noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a place or time of striking or journeying
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote the locus or time associated with striking, travel, or related activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a distance, space, or tract to be traversed
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative place noun for an extent separating two points.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a line or elongated mark on an animal's face
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical or descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: origin, ancestry, parentage, or source of descent
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The euphemistic expression مَضْرِبُ عَسَلَةٍ can refer to a person's source or lineage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the time at which a she-camel is covered by a stallion
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun used temporally by analogy with the place of the act.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a bone from which marrow is extracted or sought
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a broken bone, especially in expressions concerning an emaciated animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the striking part, edge, or lower section of a sword
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can also be used for the sword itself in some usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the case or object to which a parable or proverb is applied
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The secondary idea or situation represented by the parable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: stratagems or tactics in war
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural specialized use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an instrument used for beating, striking, or hitting
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a wooden implement used in separating cotton by striking a bowstring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a person who strikes vehemently or often
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use describing the intensity or frequency of striking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a large tent or pavilion
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a qubba or the great tent of a king.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a plectrum used to play a lute
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrumental noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: unsound or weak in the chain of transmission
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical description of a tradition whose supporting authorities are defective or unreliable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a place of agitation or of seeking the means of subsistence
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of place derived from movement or restless pursuit of livelihood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: discomfited, put to flight, or left alone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression describing someone arriving with a quivering rein.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to be excellent or skillful in striking
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a hand or arm as an idiomatic commendation of its ability in beating, striking, smiting, or hitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a sort, kind, or species
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal classification of a thing as belonging to a particular type; its plural is ضُرُوبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a likeness or like of a thing or person
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer to resemblance generally or specifically to likeness in stature and make; it also occurs in expressions meaning “the like of his saying.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: a vigorous, effective, active, lean, or slender man
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a person who is penetrating and capable in accomplishing an affair and is light or lean in flesh, not flaccid or flabby.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the last foot of a verse
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical prosodic term; its plurals include أَضْرُبٌ and ضُرُوبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: once; at one time
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression ضَرْبَةً وَاحِدَةً, the single-blow noun is used adverbially to specify a single occasion or payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a contract for one dive for pearls
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A diver agrees to dive once for a merchant at a specified price, with what he brings up belonging to the merchant; the expression is reported as a prohibited transaction.

cautions: The Quranic verb group contains active and passive forms and several construction-specific extensions; these are grouped by lexical relation rather than by grammatical voice.
The nominal ضَرْبٌ is presented as a verbal noun even though QAC tags its occurrences as nouns.
Lane's Quran citation conventions are retained only through independently secure QAC locations; no historical Lane citation has been converted into a modern location.
One Lane unit has an explicitly uncertain reading concerning a Form IV expression and is left unassigned.
